description: Change the SUBSCRIPTION plan (admin only): monthly plans with no markup on models. No argument lists them. New subscriber: a Checkout URL for the human. Existing subscriber upgrading: a quote + quote_token; once the human agrees, call again with confirm:true and quote_token to charge the card on file. Downgrade: a billing-page link; it starts at the term's end.

confirm.description: true (with quote_token) to make a quoted upgrade

plan.description: the plan id to move to (e.g. pro) — omit to list the available plans first

quote_token.description: the quoteToken from the quote step

name: upgrade_plan
title: Upgrade plan
